messages:
Juniper Lee: Hey everyone! I'm Juniper — starting today as a Product Engineer on Infra. Based in Brooklyn, big synthwave playlists, plant mom 🌿. First week in the SF office. Quick q: where's the best coffee and which fridge is the kombucha in? Badge is still blinking red so I can't get into the 3rd floor kitchen 🙃
Samira Khan: Welcome Juniper!! :tada: 3rd-floor kitchen badge should be activated by now — ping me if it's still acting up. Coffee-wise: We have a french press by the window and barista-grade beans in the closet (ask @office-ops). For kombucha, top shelf of the unlabeled fridge next to the whiteboard. Also there's a welcome snack box in the people-ops room.
Elliot Tran: welcome! If you're into synths, swing by the lounge at 4p — a few of us tinker with modular gear. Also we have a weekly bagel run on Thursdays.
Lucia Gomez: Hi Juniper! plants club meets Friday lunch for plant swaps. I have a pothos cut if you want it.
People Ops Bot: New hire checklist completed: welcome kit delivered, laptop imaged, Slack invites sent. :package:
Juniper Lee: Thanks all—saving notes. Would love that pothos, Lucia! What channel is the synth lounge chatter in?
Elliot Tran: it's #random or sometimes #lunch-music. I'll DM you about the synth meet.
Samira Khan: Badge glitch should be resolved now — try again and let me know. Also vote: would you prefer a desk plant or a welcome cookie? :cookie: :seedling: 
Lucia Gomez: planting wins :seedling: 
Elliot Tran: cookie for day 1, plant for week 1. Compromise :grin: 
Juniper Lee: plant it is. Thanks y'all :purple_heart:
